headline: New Zealand Q3 Unemployment Rises to 5.7%, Highest Since 2015
summary: New Zealand's unemployment rate climbed to 5.7% in the third quarter, reaching its highest level since 2015.
why: Quarterly labor market data influences Reserve Bank of New Zealand monetary policy decisions and interest rate expectations.

impacts.name: New Zealand
impacts.why: Unemployment rate rose to 5.7% in the third quarter.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An increase in the unemployment rate to a multi-year high points to a softening labor market.
